# Bonesetter's Draught

*Lessa's own draught for the badly hurt. Restores 60% of HP and cures poison.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Type | Consumable |
| Effect | Restores 60% HP |
| Effect | Cures poison |
| Sells for | 1,100 mesos |

## How to get

- Dropped by [The Rootdrinker](../monsters/rootdrinker.md) (60% x2-4)
- Sold at [Lessa's Remedies](../shops/midbarium_lessa.md) for 2,200 mesos
- Reward from [Grimhorn](../quests/bekk_grimhorn.md)
- Reward from [More Bites](../quests/lessa_more_bites.md)
- Reward from [The High Pasture](../quests/mabbu_the_high_pasture.md)
